items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: I left my (inaudible) there. MARCELINO GUERRA'S BAND

ctx.x: Big scandal. (Inaudible) people went crazy. I said, (inaudible) the Palladium (inaudible) Wednesday -- Sunday. And I say, Wednesday night is a bad night. Why we don't put Wednesday night a laughing show. Another night, about two nights.

Then I left again. I left New York, went back to California for my second trip, and I left my (inaudible) there. MARCELINO GUERRA'S BAND When I got back from California, they'd changed the policy of the ballroom. Instead of It's six nights a week with two matinees, from four nights a week. So I said I would never allow them to do (inaudible) there.
